pages.text: “Elegant and noble, exuding a lingering fragrance—fortune flows silently as the petals bloom.”$(br2)Peony Tea is a refined and luck-enhancing beverage made from dried peony petals. The tea is clear, slightly sweet, and rich in aroma. Drinking it grants a Luck effect, making the traveler's journey smoother and more rewarding.

$(br2)$(br)Peony Tea is simple to prepare—$(br)blend dried peony petals with sugar to create this luxurious tea.$(br)It is best consumed before gathering, exploring, or battling to improve luck and enhance rewards.

Upon drinking Peony Tea, travelers gain a Luck effect, increasing the chances of receiving extra rewards while gathering, fighting, or exploring.$(br)This tea is a fortune-enhancing drink, perfect for any adventurer seeking good luck.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
